title: Basic Command - Gameplay Prototype
subtitle: Implementation of a command fight mechanic for 2D games.
description:
This project is based on the implementation of a command-based combat system, inspired by classic turn-based RPGs. In it, two teams of three characters face each other using a system of life, damage and skills, with selection of attacker and victim. It allows player vs. player, player vs. console or even console vs. console games.

It was developed as a programming and development practice in Unity for the university course of 2D Development.

To give it more life and dynamism, I used my own recycled and animated characters.
